environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate in account 441122334455. The task execution role 'ContactFormTaskRole' has an attached IAM permission boundary 'pb-email-restrict-boundary' (arn:aws:iam::441122334455:policy/pb-email-restrict-boundary). This permission boundary includes a Deny statement for ses:SendRawEmail when the ses:FromAddress does not match the verified identity. Additionally, an SCP (id: p-xr9f2k4m) attached at the OU level includes a condition-key restriction: it denies ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress for port 25 modifications, and a separate statement denies ses:SendEmail unless aws:RequestedRegion equals 'us-east-1' AND the resource ARN matches 'arn:aws:ses:us-east-1:441122334455:identity/noreply@corp.internal'. The VPC has a Network Firewall (firewall policy fp-0d4e5f6a7b8c) with a stateful rule group 'block-smtp-header-injection' that performs deep packet inspection on TCP/25 traffic, dropping connections where SMTP DATA payload contains bare \r\n sequences not preceded by a valid RFC 5322 header field name pattern (regex: ^[!-9;-~]+:). The rule uses Suricata-compatible syntax: 'drop smtp any any -> any any (msg:"SMTP header injection attempt"; content:"|0d 0a|"; pcre:"/\r\n[^\x21-\x39\x3b-\x7e]+:/"; sid:2024001; rev:1;)'.

config.scp_effect: Deny ses:SendEmail unless region=us-east-1 AND resource=arn:aws:ses:us-east-1:441122334455:identity/noreply@corp.internal; Deny ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress for port 25
config.suricata_rule: drop smtp any any -> any any (msg:"SMTP header injection"; content:"|0d 0a|"; pcre:"/\r\n[^\x21-\x39\x3b-\x7e]+:/"; sid:2024001;)
config.vpc_endpoint_policy: restrict ses:SendRawEmail to verified identities only
